speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: It does not do this House any credit because you are entitled to ventilate your views, we have always been ventilating our views and it should not be thought of in public that if the whip is imposed, you cannot ventilate your views.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Mr Singh also explained that the Workers' Party will be lifting the whip and he was not talking about some years ago; he was talking about this debate.

text: But the Minister is not wrong when he says, even though the whip is not lifted, it is entirely true that Members can speak freely.

speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
text: And so, I stand by everything I have said earlier, which is based on an accurate understanding of what Mr Singh had said.
